title: Proposition
body_md:
Suppose that $h$ satisfies Assumption~\ref{ass:Legendreness}. Furthermore, suppose that $\nabla h(p)$ is well defined at $p \in \mbox{bd} \, \Delta(\mathcal{A})$ and $L$-coercive on $\Delta(\mathcal{A})$, i.e., there exists a constant $L> 0$ such that
    \[
        \forall\, p, \,q \in\Delta(\mathcal{A}): \quad \big\langle \nabla h(p) - \nabla h(q), \; p - q \big\rangle \geq \frac{1}{L} \big\| \nabla h(p) - \nabla h(q) \big\|_2^2.
    \]
    Let $\{ \pi_k \}_{k \geq 0}$ be the policy sequence generated by PMD \textup(Eq~\eqref{eq:PMD}\textup) with any $\eta > 0$ and $\pi_0(\cdot|s) \in \big( \mathrm{int}\, \mathrm{dom} \, h \big) \cap \Delta(\mathcal{A})$ for all $s\in\mathcal{S}$. Then there exists a finite time $T_0$ such that
    \[
        \forall\, k \geq T_0: \quad \pi_k = \pi_{T_0} \in \Pi^*,
    \]
    i.e., PMD terminates after $T_0$.

label: lem:periodic_density
title: Lemma
body_md:
\label{lem:periodic_density}
Let $f:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ be a continuous periodic function with period $T>0$, and let $\{\theta_k\}_{k\geq1}$ satisfy
\[
\theta_k\to+\infty,\qquad |\theta_{k+1}-\theta_k|\to0.
\]
Then for any fixed $a \in [0, T)$, there exists a subsequence $\{\theta_{k_m}\}_{m \geq 0}$ such that
\[
\lim_{m \to \infty} f(\theta_{k_m}) = f(a).
\]
Equivalently, $\{f(\theta_k)\}_{k\geq1}$ is dense in the range of $f$.
head: environment

title: Proof
body_md:
Fix any $a\in[0,T)$. For every sufficiently large integer $m$, define
\[
k_m:=\min\{k\geq1: \;\;\theta_k\geq mT+a\}.
\]
This index is well defined because $\theta_k\to+\infty$. Moreover, $k_m\to\infty$, and, by the minimality of $k_m$,
\[
\theta_{k_m-1}<mT+a\leq\theta_{k_m}.
\]
It follows that
\[
0\leq\theta_{k_m}-(mT+a)\leq\theta_{k_m}-\theta_{k_m-1}\leq|\theta_{k_m}-\theta_{k_m-1}|\to0.
\]
Hence $\theta_{k_m}-mT\to a$. By the periodicity and continuity of $f$,
\[
f(\theta_{k_m})=f(\theta_{k_m}-mT)\to f(a).
\]
